title: Project Overview
description: Start with the README: an AI-powered facial recognition attendance system for university classrooms with anti-spoofing liveness detection.

title: Database Models
description: The data backbone: Teacher, Class, Student, FaceEmbedding (128-dim vectors), and AttendanceRecord with a unique constraint preventing duplicate daily check-ins.

title: AI Face Engine
description: The face detection pipeline: decode base64 images, locate faces with dlib, and return 128-dimensional face embeddings for identity comparison.

title: Liveness Detection CNN
description: A custom 3-layer CNN (128x128 -> conv/pool x3 -> fc512 -> fc2) trained to distinguish real faces from photos, videos, and printout attacks.

title: ML Training Pipeline
description: Offline tooling: prepare_dataset.py extracts face frames from archive videos (real vs spoofed), generate_model.py trains the LivenessCNN.

title: Security and Authentication
description: JWT-based teacher authentication with bcrypt password hashing. Tokens are created on login and validated on every protected endpoint via OAuth2 Bearer.

title: FastAPI Application Entry Point
description: The API server: /api/auth/login (teacher login), /api/students/enroll (register face), /api/attendance/checkin (live attendance). Enforces CORS and validates liveness before saving embeddings.

title: Frontend Application Shell
description: App.jsx manages a 3-state router (not logged in -> dashboard -> kiosk) using sessionStorage for auth persistence. main.jsx boots React.

title: Teacher Login and Dashboard
description: LoginPage authenticates teachers via the backend and stores the JWT. DashboardPage lists classes and lets the teacher start a kiosk attendance session.

title: Kiosk Mode - Live Attendance
description: KioskPage captures a camera frame every 3 seconds, sends it to /api/attendance/checkin, and shows success or spoof-detection overlays. A processing lock prevents concurrent requests.
